# Firecrawl Company Directories

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — turn startup and company directories into structured lists with Firecrawl: scrape YC companies, Crunchbase, Product Hunt, G2 categories, startup directories, category directories, or any custom company database into JSON, CSV, CRM-ready lists, or research tables. Uses the Firecrawl browser when the directory needs filters, pagination, infinite scroll, or profile clicks; uses scrape/map when listings are public and static. Extracts visible fields (name, description, and whatever the directory shows). Distinct from the four published firecrawl-build-* listings: those cover API integration; this is a business workflow for prospecting and market research. Requires a Firecrawl API key — Firecrawl is a hosted, likely paid service. By @firecrawl, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the skill itself flags its limits — rate limits, login walls, and CAPTCHAs on target directories; only publicly visible fields are captured, and results depend on what each directory exposes. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
